member.name: T:SysWeaver.Media.Png.PngTools
member.summary: Portable PNG loader, decodes to 32-bit argb Byte array only. Do NOT support interlaced images - otherwise covers all files in the PngSuite: http://www.schaik.com/pngsuite/ It's verified against the WIC png codec and agrees with a MSE of zero for all files except 16-bit per pixel gray scale images (the PNG WIC doesn't seem to support 16 bpp grayscale images at all).
